families.name: Scenarios (Basic)
families.description: Basic scenario module handling up to 32 pre-programmed SCS bus scenes triggered by physical buttons or gateway events.
families.addressing: WHERE represents the scenario index (1 to 32).

families.name: Lighting
families.description: Controls ON/OFF, stepped dimming (10 levels or 1-100%), timed lighting, blinking, and transition speed across point-to-point, area, group, and general addresses.
families.addressing: WHERE can be: General ('0'), Area ('A'), Group ('#G'), Point-to-Point ('A*PL', e.g. '12' for A=1, PL=2), or Local Bus ('A*PL#4#bus').

what_commands.1: Turn ON (100% or last saved level)

1.name: Light Level / Dimming Percentage
1.description: Set or read exact dimming percentage (1-100) and optional transition speed parameter.

2.name: RGB Color Control
2.description: Control RGB values for color actuators (F429 DALI).

3.name: Tunable White / Color Temperature
3.description: Set color temperature in Kelvin for tunable white lights.

examples.description: Turn ON light at Point-to-Point address 12 (Area 1, Point 2)
Status request for light at address 12
Set light 12 to 50% brightness with transition speed 5
General Turn ON: All lights in the system

families.name: Automation (Covers & Shutters)
families.description: Controls motorized shutters, blinds, rolling gates, and venetian louvres. Supports UP, DOWN, STOP, and advanced percentage positioning.
families.addressing: WHERE can be: General ('0'), Area ('A'), Group ('#G'), Point-to-Point ('A*PL'), or Bus routed ('where#4#bus').

10.name: Absolute Position / Shutter Level
10.description: Absolute opening position percentage (0 = closed, 100 = fully open).

11.name: Slat / Louvre Tilt Angle
11.description: Tilt angle for venetian blinds (0 to 100%).

families.name: Load Control (Legacy)
families.description: Priority-based load shedding and disconnection central unit (F421) to prevent main breaker tripping.
families.addressing: WHERE represents load actuator index (1 to 8) or central unit address.

1.name: Instantaneous Load Power
1.description: Power measured on the load channel.

families.name: Heating / Thermoregulation
families.document_title: Open Web Net Language - Heating adjustment
families.description: Manages HVAC zones, heating/cooling modes, target temperatures, external temperature probes, fan speeds, and local knob offsets.
families.addressing: WHERE is zone number (1 to 99), probe number ('#0' for master probe), or central unit ('0').

what_commands.311: Set manual heating temperature with timeout (*4*311*Z#T#M##)

0.name: Measured Temperature
0.description: Zone temperature probe reading in tenths of a degree (e.g. 0215 = 21.5°C).

14.name: Target Setpoint Temperature
14.description: Target temperature in tenths of a degree (T) and operation mode (M).

22.name: Local Knob Offset
22.description: Physical thermostat knob offset (-3 to +3 degrees in 0.5 steps).

examples.description: Set Zone 1 target temperature to 20.5°C in Heating mode
Set Zone 1 to Antifreeze protection mode

families.name: Burglar Alarm
families.description: Central unit intrusion alarm status, arming, disarming, partition monitoring, and technical alarms (gas/water).
families.addressing: WHERE can be: Central unit ('0'), Zone/Partition ('1' to '8'), or Auxiliary detector.

families.name: Door Entry Call & Lock
families.description: Audio door entry calls, entrance panel ring triggers, door lock release, and staircase lighting activation.
families.addressing: WHERE is Entrance Panel address or Internal Handset address.

examples.description: Activate staircase light from door entry system

families.name: Video Door Entry / Multimedia
families.description: Video session establishment, camera cycling, and video stream routing over IP for Video Server F453AV.
families.addressing: WHERE represents external entrance panel or camera index.

families.name: Auxiliary
families.description: Auxiliary channels (AUX 1 through AUX 9) for triggering remote relays, inter-system signaling, and non-lighting loads without consuming lighting addresses.
families.addressing: WHERE represents AUX channel number (1 to 9).

families.name: Gateway Management
families.description: Gateway device management, clock/calendar synchronization, firmware versions, MAC address, uptime, and reboot commands.
families.addressing: WHERE is usually empty or '0' for the local gateway.

0.name: Date & Time Synchronization
0.description: Set or read gateway RTC clock: hour, minute, second, day of week, day, month, year.

1.name: Firmware Version
1.description: Read gateway firmware build release string.

4.name: Uptime
4.description: Gateway uptime seconds since last reboot.

examples.description: Request date and time from gateway

families.name: Actuators Diagnostics & Lock
families.description: Actuator diagnostic parameters, physical lock/unlock status, thermal overload flags, and operating cycle counters.
families.addressing: WHERE represents physical actuator address.

families.name: CEN (Scenario Pushbuttons)
families.description: Event pushbuttons configured in CEN mode. Emits short press, start of long press, and release events to trigger automations and scenario programmers.
families.addressing: WHERE format is 'A*PL#B' or 'WHERE#B' where B is the physical button number (1 to 32).

what_commands.2: End of long pressure (release after hold)
what_commands.3: Pushbutton still pressed (periodic heartbeat during long hold)

examples.description: Short press on button 2 of CEN interface at address 11
Start of long press on button 2 of CEN interface 11

families.name: Sound System / Audio
families.description: Multi-room audio matrix system. Controls amplifier power in rooms, source selection (tuner, aux, media inputs), volume level, audio follow-me, and radio station tuning.
families.addressing: WHERE can be: General ('0'), Room / Amplifier ('1' to '9'), Source ('#1' to '#4'), or Room+Source.

2.name: Radio Frequency / Tuning
2.description: FM Tuner frequency in kHz (e.g. 102500 for 102.5 MHz).

examples.description: Turn ON audio amplifier in Room 1
Turn OFF audio amplifier in Room 1

families.name: Scene Management (Advanced / MH200N)
families.description: Advanced programmable scenarios executing conditional logic, timers, logical equations, and complex multi-subsystem scenes on MH200/MH200N controllers.
families.addressing: WHERE represents the advanced scenario ID (1 to 300).

families.name: Energy Management
families.description: Monitors electricity, water, and gas meters. Provides instantaneous active power in Watts, total accumulated energy in Wh/kWh, and hourly/daily/monthly pulses.
families.addressing: WHERE indicates meter probe line: '1' to '255', or '#1' to '#3' for multi-phase tariffs.

2.name: Hourly Consumption Totalizer
2.description: Energy consumed in the current hour (Wh).

11.name: Lifetime Accumulated Energy Totalizer
11.description: Total cumulative energy recorded by meter (Wh).

examples.description: Request instantaneous active power from meter 1

families.name: Sound Diffusion (Extended)
families.description: Extended audio matrix commands supporting granular spatial balance, multi-zone volume grouping, and DSP profile switching.
families.addressing: WHERE represents extended audio zone.

families.name: Lighting Management / DALI
families.description: DALI ballasts and advanced lighting management. Direct ballast addressing, DALI groups, emergency lighting status, and daylight harvesting sensor integration.
families.addressing: WHERE represents DALI Gateway address followed by ballast or group index.

examples.description: Turn ON DALI ballast 1 on gateway 1

families.name: CEN+ / Dry Contacts
families.description: Modern CEN+ pushbuttons and dry contact interfaces. Supports up to 255 buttons per interface with distinct short press, start pressure, release, and contact state signals.
families.addressing: WHERE represents interface address 'A*PL' or 'WHERE', button number is in what/dimension parameter.

families.name: Diagnostic (Lighting / Bus)
families.description: Low-level SCS physical layer diagnostic frames for lighting bus topology, actuator responsiveness, and short-circuit warnings.
families.addressing: WHERE represents diagnostic target actuator.

examples.description: Query physical diagnostics for lighting node 12

families.name: Heating Diagnostic
families.description: HVAC probe diagnostics, sensor battery status, probe open/short circuit fault codes, and communication timeouts.
families.addressing: WHERE is zone or probe number.

examples.description: Query probe diagnostic status for zone 1

families.name: Gateway Diagnostic
families.description: Gateway buffer status, active connection sockets, TCP queue depth, and internal memory state.
families.addressing: WHERE is local gateway ('0').
